x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

if n >= y:
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    numerator = x // g
    denominator = y // g
else:
    min_difference = float('inf')
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    target = x / y
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        lower = math.floor((x * i) / y)
        diff_lower = abs((lower / i) - target)
        if diff_lower < min_difference:
            min_difference = diff_lower
            numerator = lower
            denominator = i
        upper = math.ceil((x * i) / y)
        diff_upper = abs((upper / i) - target)
        if diff_upper < min_difference:
            min_difference = diff_upper
            numerator = upper
            denominator = i

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
